Although the stepped thickness was leveled, every fillet operation failed because makeFillet was called directly on CadQuery Solid/Compound objects, which do not provide that method in this environment. Consequently, the rendered model retained sharp box edges, no R20 junction fillets, no general R5 fillets, and effectively failed the complete chamfer/radius replacement requirement. The updated function uses CadQuery Workplane.fillet, cleans the fused body into one solid, explicitly selects the four exposed horizontal shoulder edges for R20, applies R5 to the remaining original exterior edges, and rounds the pocket and bore edges.
